issue_body: Starting a request with a cancellation signal that has already been triggered does not stop the request: it proceeds and contacts the server as though no cancellation was requested. A signal triggered after the request has started cancels it as expected.
prompt: Starting a request with a cancellation signal that has already been triggered does not stop the request: it proceeds and contacts the server as though no cancellation was requested. A signal triggered after the request has started cancels it as expected.
expected_behavior: A pre-aborted signal causes the request to fail immediately with an abort error.
A non-aborted signal passed to a request allows the request to proceed normally.
Aborting a signal mid-request still cancels the request.
Successful requests with a signal that is never aborted complete normally.
